capabilities: Edit CSV and TSV cells in a tabular view with live preview
Toggle between table editing, source-plus-preview, and read-only views
Resize columns and rows manually or fit them to contents
Filter records with search and paste multi-cell blocks
Autosave after idle pauses and recover from on-disk edit conflicts
extras: Interface is in Simplified Chinese; install is manual (release files into the plugins folder); mobile behavior is unverified; the plugin asks users to disable other plugins that claim CSV/TSV files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in editor for CSV/TSV files, so delimited data has to be edited in outside tools or as raw text.

relations.evidence: CSV parsing uses Papa Parse under the MIT license

summary: CSV/TSV editor that opens delimited files in an Obsidian tab with cell editing, source-and-preview mode, resizable rows and columns, autosave and conflict recovery.
